finite_counterterm.A: I^CT[eps] -> I^CT[eps] + (27/16) u int(d^*A|_V, d^*A|_V) (i.e. J = I - I^CT[eps] - (27/16) u int(d^*A|_V,d^*A|_V)); the obstruction in this sector then vanishes. Equivalently: the renormalised A|_V self-energy carries the finite local longitudinal term (27/16) u int(d^*A|_V, d^*A|_V), which this counterterm removes. No int(A|_V,A|_V) finite counterterm is needed (eps^{-1} cancels exactly).
finite_counterterm.B: F = (27/16) u int (d*A|_V, d*A|_V) added to I^CT[eps] (renormalised interaction I - I^CT[eps] - F); then D changes by -Q F = -O and the quadratic obstruction vanishes. In Lemma 12.0.4 form: lift S + hbar S' with S' = -(27/16)(tr_g(ad_X ad_Y)/((X,Y)16pi^2)) int (d*A|_V,d*A|_V).

cross_check_route.A: longitudinal finite coefficient 27/8 -> Q W_1 = -(27/8) u int(d^*dc, d^*A|_V) and eps^{-1}: -(9/2) u eps^{-1} int(dc,A|_V): identical to the special-edge sum (exact agreement, including the cancellation of all log 2 terms)
cross_check_route.B: exact: eps^-1 -9/2 and finite -27/8 from both routes; the gauge-loop and ghost-loop log(p^2 eps) and log 2 pieces cancel in the sum

cubic_sector.A: OPEN (not computed). Reduction established here: after the quadratic finite counterterm the cubic part of the obstruction is the eps -> 0 limit of the special-edge 1PI loops with three legs (leg contents (c,A|_V,A|_V), (c,A|_Wperp,A|_Wperp), (c,lambda,lambda), (c,c,A^*|_V)); special-edge bridges cancel against the bridge part of -{I,I^CT}_eps; s I^CT[eps] has no cubic part (log part: s^2 Psi = 0 by T1; eps^{-1} part: {I, int(A,A)} = 2 int([A,c],A) = 0). The three-edge special-edge region integrals (t_0 in [0,eps], two t_e in [eps,infty), Taylor order 2 in external momenta) are not done.
cubic_sector.B: open (not computed): requires triangles and quartic-vertex bubbles with one special edge, the vertex {I, I^CT[eps]}_eps, and the one-particle-reducible graphs -Q I^CT[eps] --P-- I. Structural statement only: the one-loop obstruction is closed under Q + {I,-}, so its cubic part equals (27/16) u {I, int (d*A|_V,d*A|_V)} (cubic part) plus a (Q + {I,-})-closed cubic remainder.
